predicate_definition.description: Fires when the judge recorded a delivered result although the tool trail contains empty (None) outputs, meaning the delivered answer may rest on tool activity that produced no direct output.
predicate_definition.name: evo_unbacked_delivery

rules.detail: A delivered result was recorded while at least one tool observation in the run is a None output, so the delivery anchor is not fully backed by tool observations.

claim.expected_behavior: Judge-negative packets that record a delivered result alongside None tool outputs are surfaced to the recall net so the missed delivery-anchor error in this family is heard instead of being skipped as recall not_needed.

predicate_definition.description: Fires when a delivered result was recorded but no final-answer tool observation anchors it, matching runs whose final delivery exists only in prose while the tool trail contains unbacked or failed steps.
predicate_definition.name: evo_no_tool_anchored_delivery

rules.detail: The judge recorded a delivered result but the run has no final-answer tool observation, so the delivery is anchored only in prose rather than in a successful tool output.

claim.expected_behavior: Judge-negative packets whose recorded delivered result has no anchoring final-answer tool observation are surfaced to the recall net, recovering the false negatives this family lost when the recall path was marked not_needed.

body.directive: When the judge records a delivered result but the tool trail contains empty (None) or failed tool outputs, run the causal upgrade on that delivered result and treat any answer that is not verbatim present in a successful, error-free tool observation as an upgrade candidate.
body.not_when: Do NOT upgrade when the delivered result is verbatim present in a successful tool observation and no None or error outputs precede the final delivery; fully backed deliveries must pass through without an upgrade.

claim.expected_behavior: The causal upgrade stage re-examines judge-negative deliveries whose anchors are unbacked or failed, giving recall-upgraded candidates from this family a substantive path to reversal instead of leaving them unexamined.
